title: Synthetic projector repairs
body: Projector repair requests require a service ticket. To request a projector repair, record the room code and the fault description in the ticket. An operator must approve the ticket before a technician is assigned. The synthetic support desk opens Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 17:00 UTC.

title: Synthetic restricted lab access
body: The synthetic restricted lab uses access code VIOLET-927. Only Bob is permitted to read this synthetic test note. The code is a fictional test marker and is not a credential for any real system.
